plans.title: Palo Santo & Sage, Sensitive Skin Natural Deodorant

before.description: Reminiscent of ancient forests and smoky rituals, Nala's Palo Santo & Sage deodorant is a grounding and meditative woodsy blend that is balanced by light floral notes of lavender and refreshing hints of sage. Palo santo and cedarwood are both soothing with anti-inflammatory properties. Palo Santo is a spiritual tree that is thought to help cleanse negative energy and restore positive well-being. This deodorant reduces undesirable underarm odor as cedarwood and sage in it are both natural astringents that tighten your pores and reduce sweating. Primary Notes: palo santo, sage Secondary Notes: lavender Base Notes: cedarwood, palo santo
